entries.subject: Hedman et al. Polydeuces measured axes
entries.finding: Hedman et al. (2020), Table 1 and Appendix B supply semiaxes 1.75 × 1.55 × 1.31 km, each with ±0.20 km uncertainty. The selected analytic ellipsoid approximates the overall dimensions and does not reconstruct local terrain.

entries.subject: Cassini N1527002576 CL1/IR1 pointing evidence
entries.finding: The selected near-infrared frame is a coarse pointing record; at about 9 by 7 pixels it cannot establish surface-feature registration.

entries.subject: Finer 2015 Polydeuces crescent
entries.finding: The inspected crescent mixes strong Saturnshine with direct solar illumination and was not used as a surface patch.
entries.revisitWhen: A comparable higher-resolution view with separable illumination and registration can be assessed.

entries.subject: Polydeuces shape, terrain and composition alternatives
entries.finding: No body-specific PDS shape deliverable, DEM, geology or spatial composition product was qualified; integrated photometry is not mapped.
entries.revisitWhen: A registered body-specific shape or spatial product can support a qualified route.
